correctness.rationale: For n>=2 simple Möbius ladders, reduced-Laplacian injectivity makes log det strictly concave on its positive-definite domain; the global optimizer is uniquely orbit-symmetric. Fourier even and odd modes yield tau=n b^(2n-1)(T_n(1+a/b)+1), and the derivative at the deleted-rung boundary is [n²-(2n-1)t]/2. Hyperbolic stationary conditions prove the fixed-t and t/n->c limits, with c=1/2 borderline handled separately. Independently checked 24 exact rational Laplacian determinants against Chebyshev identity including n=2 and rung deletion. Finite computation is diagnostic; Steps 1-5 support all quantifiers.
